summary_1line: Angada condemns Sugriva’s morality and, fearing punishment, vows to fast to death rather than return to Kishkindha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada, surrounded by weary monkeys on a rocky shore, raises his hand in a solemn vow to fast until death.
The monkey warriors sit despondently on the barren ground as Angada speaks bitterly about Sugriva’s betrayal.
